description: Free GIS Data (rtwilson) (curated list) is a curated catalogue listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets, published or maintained by Robin Wilson (community list). It is a curated list of free geographic datasets with 512 entries, grouped by physical and human geography and by country; 107 of them fall inside the scope of this catalogue and are recorded separately. Coverage: worldwide, as listed. It is a single web page maintained by one person. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the list site; linked resources carry their own terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding free geographic data for infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
licence: not stated on the list site; linked resources carry their own terms
